svg.text: 67% of the 716 tests that took >10 min were waiting
4,212 test runs between Nov 11 and Nov 16.
Why the queue: test slots were cut from 8 to 4 (8 at once ran out of memory and froze a live service),
once to 1, with ~20 sessions wanting tests. Slow runs: mostly full suites at merge/review (median ~19 min).
1) one shared pool for sessions + tests (20) 2) full suites only for merge/review, max 2; dev runs targeted tests
3) 15-minute circuit breaker 4) no new tests when free memory is low. To be re-measured Nov 19.
Source: the test queue run log (runs.jsonl).
